articles.title: Starbucks to close 250 stores: 'Difficult decision' - Fox Business
articles.description: Starbucks COO Mike Grams revealed plans to shutter about 250 coffeehouses across North America, citing struggles with financial performance.
articles.content:
Starbucks announced plans to close roughly 250 stores across North America this week, company COO Mike Grams revealed Thursday.
